app_release_notes: v1.17.3 - A different test now always gets its own load. Importing new charges into a load that already has speeds can no longer mix two tests together. Compare Loads shows each load's name and length, so loads with the same powder and charge are easy to tell apart. Plus fixes and improvements.

windows.app_release_notes: v1.17.2 - Barrel tuner: the recommended setting now always uses the same numbers as your settings table, and tuner tests count up from your start setting, the way tuner instructions run. Enter your seating length as COAL as well as CBTO or a jump. Results and your Recipe Card say which one you measured. New Every shot button on Results shows every shot's speed, and long strings now count every shot. Double-click a load in Libraries to open it. Plus fixes and improvements.
